verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes immigration guidance, such as an EB-1A approval-rate blog post and a premium-processing timeline. Nothing in the evidence shows these claims cite USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or linked official policy sources. The homepage metrics are the company's own operational counters, not government data.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links
